# Maru

> Maru is a small iPhone app for daily supplements and simple medication schedules. It reminds you on time, shows what to take now, and keeps a record you can trust. It is in early development and is not on the App Store yet.

Facts:
- Free core. No account, no ads, no tracking, no cloud. Data stays on the iPhone.
- Today screen: record a dose with one tap, or a whole part of the day with one tap.
- Local reminders at the times you choose, with an optional "Remind Again".
- History with undo and correction. CSV export, backup, and restore.
- Maru does not track stock, give medical advice, or pick a dose or a time for you.
- Maru has no Apple Watch app and no sync between devices.

Pages:
- [FAQ](https://maru.day/faq.html): short answers.
- [Compare](https://maru.day/compare.html): Maru, Apple Health Medications, and Medisafe.
- [Privacy](https://maru.day/privacy.html): what the app stores and what it does not do.
- [Support](https://maru.day/support.html): hello@maru.day and the feedback form.
- [Source](https://github.com/ImHangLi/maru): MIT license.
